title: Weekly AI Worldview | Zhipu Raises Multi-Billion RMB at ¥20B Valuation; SSI Raises $1B; Kevin Kelly’s Three AI-Era Predictions

html:
Unique Research · Company / Weekly Digest · September 9, 2024

China funding

Zhipu AI (智谱) — new round of multi-billion RMB; valuation to ¥20 billion. Lead story investor: Zhongguancun Science City Company (Haidian-backed market platform). Also: Hillhouse, Qiming, Legend Capital, plus Meituan, Alibaba, Tencent, Xiaomi. 2024 focus: commercialization + multimodal. B-side: API, cloud private, on-prem; open platform bigmodel.cn with 500k+ customers. C-side: paid “Zhipu Qingyan” + video model “Qingying.” Ecosystem fund for upstream/downstream invest & incubate.

Zheta Tech (喆塔科技) — strategic round led jointly by Optics Valley Financial Holdings, Zhangke Yaokun, Hefei Industrial Investment. Industrial big data + industrial AI; one-stop CIM 2.0 platform for semiconductor / display / new energy smart factories.

Dongyi Tech (动易科技) — multi-million-RMB angel led by FreeS Fund and Z Fund (Zhipu ecosystem), Qingzhi Capital participating. Founded Jun 2024; CEO Ren Xiaoyu (legged humanoids + RL). Behavior-motion AI agents + next-gen humanoid bodies; imitation + RL path; humanoid demo targeted next year.

Overseas funding

Safe Superintelligence (SSI) — Ilya Sutskever co-founded; $1B+ from NFDG (Nat Friedman / Daniel Gross), a16z, Sequoia, DST Global, SV Angel. Split across Palo Alto and Tel Aviv for compute + talent. Valuation reported ~$5B. Research direction still opaque; Sutskever previously led OpenAI’s dissolved Superalignment team before exiting after the Altman board clash.

Sakana AI (Japan) — $100M Series A led by NEA, Khosla, Lux; Nvidia participating. Founders: ex-Google researchers David Ha & Llion Jones + Ren Ito. Nature-inspired “collective intelligence” of smaller models; aim to challenge frontier labs with Nvidia infra in a talent-dense Japan lab.

You.com — $50M Series B led by Georgian; Nvidia, Salesforce Ventures. Founder Richard Socher (ex-Salesforce chief scientist). “Productivity engine” class; 1B+ queries; claimed +500% revenue since January; multi-model access as antidote to enterprise “AI sprawl.”

Bland AI — $16M Series A led by Scale VP; $22M total (YC, Max Levchin, ElevenLabs CTO, Twilio’s Jeff Lawson). Ultra-realistic voice agents for support / sales / internal calls — efficiency pitch with ethics pushback.

Supio (Seattle legaltech, ex-Microsoft engineers, 2021) — $25M Series A led by Sapphire; Bonfire, Foothill; $33M total. Unstructured PI / mass-tort case data + chatbot extraction; subscription by case volume; headcount to roughly double in a year.

All Hands AI — $5M seed led by Menlo. OpenHands agent project: 30k+ GitHub stars, 150+ contributors; automate tests/deploys so engineers focus on creative work; enterprise closed-source add-ons planned while keeping OSS funded.

Industry moves — China

Baidu — Wenxin Yiyan app rebranded Wen Xiaoyan (文小言) as “new search” assistant: rich-media search, multimodal input, text/image creation, high-fidelity digital humans; memory + free-subscribe features; Wenxin 4.0 free for all users through September.

Alipay / Ant at Bund Summit — first service AI app on Ant BaiLing model: Zhi Xiaobao (支小宝) life butler (book tickets, order food, ride-hail via natural language). Agent ecosystem + “Treasure Box” agent builder for merchants.

MiniMax — first HD video model abab-video-1 at Link Partner Day: high-res / high-fps, high compression, filmic styles. Founder Yan Junjie: later than peers but focused on training-cost/compression. Live on Hailuo AI; image-to-video and mixed text/image→video next; partner ecosystem push.

Industry moves — overseas

Salesforce — agreed to acquire voice-agent startup Tenyx (undisclosed; expected Q3 close). Founders Itamar Arel & Adam Earle join; verticals include e-com, healthcare, hospitality, travel — M&A back on after buyback-heavy period.

Safran — €220M (~$243M) for defense/aero AI Preligens → Safran.AI under Electronics & Defense; satellite imagery auto-detect of military-relevant objects.

Samsung Medison — acquired French AI ultrasound startup Sonio for KRW 126.5B (~€86M). FDA-cleared Sonio Detect (1M+ real ultrasound images); remains France-HQ’d and multi-vendor compatible.

SK Hynix / Samsung geography (H1): SK Hynix U.S. revenue +192.2% to ~$11.83B (55.4% mix) on HBM3/HBM3E to Nvidia; China +121.7%. Samsung Americas +21.3%, China +97.8%. TrendForce: China CSP stockpiling ahead of possible U.S. curbs.

People

Xiong Yun (熊云) — ex-ByteDance / Volcano Engine DataWind & CDP lead; new company Jiuyun Shuzhi (九云数智) on native data apps; Tsinghua + Cisco/Baidu/Byte background; teammate Cui Xuan (reported ex-Baidu eng).

Kevin Kelly at Inclusion·Bund Summit — three AI-era trends: globalism (tech “super-organism” fusing culture), accelerated innovation (faster invention/diffusion; asking > answering), and AI-driven generation (new kinds of intelligence and culture). Diversity of AIs; free humans from dull work; urge participation + open-source for inclusive ecosystems.

Note (from CN close): limited free tickets for an AI-marketing event via comment interest.

— END —
